name: Governing
overview: Scripture teaches that governing authorities are established by God and hold power only by His permission, as seen in Romans 13:1 and John 19:11. When righteous leaders govern, the people rejoice, but wicked rule brings sorrow, highlighting the moral responsibility of those in authority (Proverbs 29:2). Believers are called to respect and honor governing powers by rendering what is due, yet must always obey God above men when the two are in conflict (Romans 13:7; Acts 5:29). This underscores a Christ-centered view of governance that acknowledges divine sovereignty over earthly rulers.
